text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, what's done is done. Let's shift 
gears and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It hurts... It hurts so much...! The 
Derby... my dream...!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—...Still. I can't just spend all my time 
being frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win next time! And with my head held 
high...! I'm gonna go see Ma and the 
others!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...She's already looking ahead. Spe-chan 
really is strong.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Still, the one who wins next time... 
might just be me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky and Special Week had yielded 
victory to another Umamusume. Even so, 
those around them evaluated—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Damn it! Spe-chan lost. Still, she's got 
plenty of room to grow...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That girl's strength is the real 
deal. She's gonna transform over the 
coming summer! I'm definitely keeping my 
eyes on Spe-chan next time too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan really is popular, isn't she? 
Even after a loss, people still have high 
hopes for her future.
choice_data_list: Still, Sky put up a great fight too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But... I agree that Spe-chan still 
has plenty of room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I guess I gotta get even stronger by the 
Kikuka-sho~... Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the final leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka-sho, 
summer arrives for the Umamusume.
